turnaround_source.label: Turnaround source background
turnaround_source.text: Use a plain smooth neutral light gray studio background. The background must be matte, evenly lit, low-texture, and easy to separate from the character silhouette. Do not use mottled paint texture, vignette, patterned backdrop, floor seam, strong cast shadow touching the body silhouette, scenery, props, text, labels, or a chroma-key green-screen color.
